steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content:
Chief... Is it really okay for a Sinner to visit family? 
Would it cause too much trouble for you?
Seeing you wearing the sheriff's uniform of Eastside, Ariel can't help but show her concern.

options: I've already taken care of it.

choices.text: I've already taken care of it.

steps.content: Your crime is rather minor. Guess I can bend the rules a bit.
However, our identities are sensitive and should not be exposed in Eastside.
So from now on, you're not a Sinner, and I'm not the Chief of the MBCC.
I'm an Eastside sheriff who helps missing girls return home.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I understand, Chie... ${PlayerName}.
The Bureau's car is stopped in front of the Spencers' home.
Ariel stands outside the door, gripping the doorknob. She is hesitating to push the door open.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: D-Do you think my father will be more concerned about me because I haven't been home for so many days?
She shakes her head helplessly to herself.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: If he really were concerned about me, the streets of Eastside would be filled with my missing person notices...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: So I was imagining the impossible... I knew it.
Ariel takes a deep breath and pushes open the door carved with the Spencer family crest.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Father... I'm home.
Ariel enters the study awkwardly to see the expression of the middle-aged man on the couch.
The man is so focused on the newspaper in his hands that he does not even raise an eyebrow.
It is only when Ariel walks up to him that he reacts.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Ariel? I heard from the butler that you were missing.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: It's good that you know to come home.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Father, don't you want to know what I've gone through in these few days?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: There's a lot I need to know every day, so there's no need to tell me if it's not that important.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: But for this sheriff's help, I... I almost couldn't see you again!
She raises her voice involuntarily, eager to argue.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Then go take your sheriff friend to have fun somewhere as an expression of gratitude.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Hmm, your brothers and sisters made a lot of achievements lately. The new product line has brought a lot of profits for the family.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: You should learn from them.
Ganson's eyes are locked on the news, not sparing a single moment to look at Ariel.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Is there nothing to talk about other than the family business?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: You're very talkative today.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Maybe it's because it's been too long since I last saw you, father. I kind of miss you.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: So what can we talk about? Is it your stagnating artistic attainment or your contribution to the family business?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: We can talk about everyday father-daughter topics. For example, your health. Have you been feeling better lately?
Ariel seems to be making one last attempt, stubbornly or even desperately trying to elicit a different reaction from her father.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: The nutritionist will take care of that. All you have to do is take care of yourself and be there when the family needs you.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: When the family needs me?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: What? Do you not understand your responsibilities even at this age?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Use your marriage for the benefit of the family. That is the only way you can be useful to the Spencers.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: But there are things I want to do. I don't live only for our family.

This is perhaps the first time Ariel has resisted her father and explained her thoughts in front of him. Her hands are clenching the corners of her dress, and her voice is trembling, but she speaks bravely and firmly.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Did you know? I recently saved a person...

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Haha! Great! Great!

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: A good Maniac is a dead Maniac. These thugs should all be driven to the Rust!
He shows pleasure from the news article at hand, completely oblivious to Ariel's words.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Oh right, what did you just say?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I said...
You see Ariel clench her fists, her shoulders lightly trembling.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I said... I am a Sinner now.
Ariel, didn't we agree...
Ganson finally closes the newspaper and has his attention on his daughter.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: That's enough! You can continue your philanthropic deeds if you think that will give you a sense of accomplishment.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: But you have to bear in mind the Spencer family's stance and not make jokes about Sinners.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I was not making jokes...
Ariel stretches out her right hand, in which a ball of light is condensing.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Don't worry, my ability is not that dangerous. I am learning to control it to help others...

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Stay away!
Ganson hastily throws the newspaper at Ariel's feet, gasping in rage.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Y-You! What is your intention of returning to the family in this state?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I just wanted to see you one last time before being taken into custody by the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: See me? More like using your wicked ability to get back at me and the family!

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I had no intention of doing that, Fa...

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Don't call me father! It makes me sick to the stomach.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: I order you, Sinner Ariel, to get out of here, or else...
He pulls out an old pistol from under his desk.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: You aren't going to shoot, are you?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: It's hard to say against a family traitor!

options: Are you going to kill your own daughter?

choices.text: Are you going to kill your own daughter?

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: I almost forgot you're still there, sheriff.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: I'm just defending myself from a trespassing Sinner.
This is her home.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: It no longer is.
Ganson raises his gun and aims it at Ariel.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: To let you stand in front of me is already the greatest tolerance I can give a Sinner.
Ariel may be a Sinner, but she has no ill intentions!
She came back this time because she missed her father.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Heck, Sinners are the best at lying!

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: No ill intentions? That's because the time is not ripe!

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Let me show you the most heinous look of a Sinner!
Bang!!!
Ariel looks down in disbelief at the bullet hole in her left shoulder.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I am... I am your daughter!
Bang!!!
Ganson's hand pulls the trigger and a second bullet flies straight toward Ariel.
Light bursts out as the living room shakes uncontrollably due to Ariel's ability.
The bullet is deflected by Ariel's ball of light, and the gun in Ganson's hand is knocked away.

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Hahahahah, I knew it! I knew it!

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: Did you see that, sheriff? She just tried to murder her own father!!!

steps.speaker: Ganson
steps.content: This is the true color of a Sinner! An eternal enemy of the Spencer family!
Ariel covers the wound on her left shoulder and looks disappointingly at the man she called "father."

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content:
I knew it would turn out like this...
Let's go, Chief...
Without any explanation or argument, she walks out of the study in a daze with your assistance. The two of you exit the front door of the Spencers' house.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Don't worry, Chief. I'm good.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I did what I came here to do... Cough cough cough.
Don't speak. You're bleeding a lot. I'll call in the medical team.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Chief... Could you promise me one thing?
Ariel's face is pale and she is breaking out in cold sweat.
Can't we talk about it when we've returned?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I-I'm afraid I will regret it by then...
Alright, I promise. What is it?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I want my father to believe that he has killed me today...
Why? Is that why you had to come home?

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: I was so naïve that I still harbor that unrealistic dream... I couldn't help thinking, what if? What if he would show a different attitude towards his daughter...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: Now I have got his answer, I can finally give up... Perhaps this is...

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: HUSH... What are you doing here?
Ariel leans helplessly on your shoulder, her breath slowly fading.
In the distance, you hear the sound of a car approaching.
Ariel! Wake up! The medical team is here!
Ariel!!!
